summary: Edge medical segmentation must reconcile small model size, high accuracy, and fast inference. TernScope addresses this tradeoff through model--hardware co-design, learning a compact segmentation network whose low-bit operators also simplify hardware execution.
takeaways: TernScope addresses this tradeoff through model--hardware co-design, learning a compact segmentation network whose low-bit operators also simplify hardware execution.
Split-channel large-kernel blocks preserve spatial context with limited computation, while branch fusion removes redundant inference paths.
All 25 convolutions use ternary weights and 8-bit activations, enabling packed storage and multiplier-free computation.
